notes: Posted 14 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under Starting (7): TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF, CC Upper Walkway, Secret Plans, Prepared Defenses, I'm Sorry, IAO, Mob Points; these count toward the 60. Secret Plans is the 2001 Effect, not a Defensive Shield.

Posted 'TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further; 'IAO' Imperial Arrest Order (missing from the machine draft); 'Mob Points' Mobilization Points.

Posted 'Empy' dested Emperor Palpatine; 'EPP Vader' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'DV, DLOS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Janus' Janus Greejatus; 'Thrawn' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul.

The two Weapons are posted under crude joke names: 'Mara's Vibrator' dested Mara Jade's Lightsaber and 'Vaders Dildo' dested Vader's Lightsaber (the deck runs Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand and three Vaders; the Premiere Vader's Lightsaber matches the posted 'Vaders').
Posted 'Bespin', 'Bespin Cloud City', 'Cloud City Downtown Plaza' and 'Cloud City West Gallery' dested the Dark pages; Blizzard 2 and Tempest 1 are vehicles posted under Starships/Vehicles.
The wiki's John Anderson page is a 2016–2018 tournament player with no link to the DeckTech handle Alpha Blue; same name, nothing contradicts, so the existing page is used.
